details: For finite concept classes, diameter dominates Littlestone dimension.
name: Diameter / Littlestone Dimension
witness_verification: For the family #classes/trivial_concepts with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
